dimensions.authority: authored fitting estimates, not dimensions recovered from a photograph

features.observed: Squat irregular domed stone assembly, deep joints, distinct angular rock silhouettes; no smooth egg surface
features.representation: Individual staggered faceted rock meshes forming lower walls and upper dome; dark recessed mortar backing; rough rock albedo and micro-normal textures
features.proof: Front-left close render and unlit geometry pass show individual stones and joint depth

features.observed: Irregular wedge stones framing deep arched fire opening with visible inner stonework
features.representation: Separate wedge stones, actual open cavity, inner wall and hearth floor; preserve dark depth without opaque front blockage
features.proof: Source-angle render and direct-front diagnostic reveal arch silhouette and interior

features.observed: Horizontal lower strap and vertical/diagonal bands across dome, numerous rivets, plate junctions and securing feet
features.representation: Bent strip meshes following stone profile, separate beveled plates, rivet heads, foot plates with actual holes
features.proof: Full silhouette and close render show every visible reference strap; no band crosses hearth

features.observed: Short circular top aperture with thick worn iron collar and warm interior
features.representation: Open annular collar mesh and recessed emissive inner ring, not a capped cylinder
features.proof: Elevated close render shows open center and rim thickness

features.observed: Fan-shaped folded brown leather between shaped wooden rails, visible stitching, iron hinge and nozzle
features.representation: Separate fan pleat surfaces, profiled timber rails, hinge pins, stitch detail and nozzle connected to hearth side; no square leather sandwich
features.proof: Side close render compared to reference fan profile and wood/leather/iron separation

features.observed: Small battered cup with thick irregular rim attached beside front lower wall
features.representation: Hollow irregular cup mesh, thick rim and securing bracket; rough dark metal surface
features.proof: Reference-angle render shows interior and bracket without oversized bowl

features.observed: Distinct dark/grey charcoal with glowing orange cracks and some warmer stones inside cavity
features.representation: Separate coal meshes with localized emission mask; hearth glow kept separate from albedo
features.proof: Off/on emission renders preserve dark stones rather than uniformly orange cavity

features.observed: Mottled angular stone, rust at iron joints, worn edges, wood grain, dirty stitched leather
features.representation: Material-specific UV textures for albedo, tangent normal, roughness/metallic and AO; no photographic highlights baked into albedo
features.proof: Blender and Unity close renders with explicit map bindings, normal sampling and roughness inspected

review.camera: Reference-like front-left three-quarter, authored approximate calibration; orthographic geometry diagnostics separate
review.lights: Explicit neutral world and area key/fill, no inherited scene lights; log transforms, strengths, exposure and display transform
review.gate: Inspect actual saved Blender scene, exported geometry and imported Unity material state. Show source and actual render before any other station modelling. Diagnose geometry/material/camera/export differences before rerendering. No exact-match claim from dimensions or a successful build.
